faq_heading: Homes near Brookswood Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Brookswood Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Brookswood Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Brookswood Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Brookswood Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Langley Fundamental Middle/Secondary Sch (1.1 km north-east), Belmont Elementary (1.2 km west) and Noel Booth Elementary (1.4 km south-west).

Brookswood Secondary is a secondary school in Langley (Langley School District), at 20902 37a Ave. It teaches grades 8 to 12. Programs listed: French Immersion (district find-a-school tag); Academies (district find-a-school tag).
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Brookswood Secondary.
How the Brookswood Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Brookswood Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Brookswood Secondary

13 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Brookswood Secondary in a straight line (10 elementary, 2 other, 1 middle; 2 independent). The closest is Langley Fundamental Middle/Secondary Sch, 1.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is James Hill Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Belmont Elementary (1.2 km); the nearest independent school is St Catherines School (1.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Belmont Elementary (1.2 km).
